steps.note: Run with -Set javelin -ClientCount 1 -Gear "BIL SCALPEL" -LogShots. The Javelin has to LOCK before it launches: two seconds of aim held on a vehicle inside the 0.99-dot cone with a clear line of sight. Before 2026-09-27 the server read a destroyed pointSampler on every pull, so no networked player had ever launched one.
